title: Snowboard Hero
notes: Physical ARM64 retest on 2026-10-06 with IPA SHA-256 74efc6f5ea00502df2dfbaa243472daa013d0ee209edcbc373880b2af5761fab. Loading completes, the main menu renders correctly, and tapping Play opens the mode-selection screen. Tapping Career reproducibly terminates the emulator before a race appears. The native tombstone reports SIGSEGV at null in libc __memcpy, called through the Adreno GLES1 glDrawElements path and Super Duper's GLES guest bridge. A prior manual attempt by the owner also reached the start of a race before crashing. No race screenshot or verified in-game controls are available from this retest.
